scene.background: golden, textured sandy beach with visible footprints and scattered towels
scene.lighting: bright and natural, with strong sunlight casting soft shadows on the sand and buildings, indicating midday. The white balance is slightly warm, enhancing the golden tones of the sand and the vividness of the sea
scene.camera_angle: slightly tilted downward, emphasizing the sweeping curve of the shoreline and the gentle waves lapping the sand
scene.style: photorealistic, capturing fine textures: the granular sand, the fabric of towels, the wetness of the waves, and the architectural details of the buildings
scene.mood: relaxed, joyful, and idyllic — a classic summer day at a Mediterranean seaside resort
scene.color_palette: vibrant yet natural, with rich, saturated blues, greens, and warm earth tones — the palette is vibrant yet natural, with no artificial tones

attributes.texture: gentle, foamy waves breaking near the shore
attributes.gradient: smooth from deep blue to lighter turquoise

attributes.architecture: Mediterranean-style with shuttered windows, wrought-iron balconies, and terracotta roofs
attributes.color: pastel facades — mint green, peach, light yellow, and terracotta
